setup: 1. Edite o no 'Credenciais e Config' com clickup_api_key, supabase_url e supabase_service_key
2. Configure webhook no ClickUp: POST {N8N_URL}/webhook/clickup-comment-webhook para o evento taskCommentPosted
3. No Maestr.ia Settings -> n8n, configure 'Webhook URL: Comentarios ClickUp' com {N8N_URL}/webhook/clickup-comment-from-maestria
_readme.fluxo_maestria_para_clickup: Maestr.ia envia comentario -> Webhook -> Normalizar -> POST /task/{id}/comment na API do ClickUp
_readme.fluxo_clickup_para_maestria: ClickUp dispara webhook taskCommentPosted -> Normalizar -> Busca task pelo clickup_task_id -> Insere via RPC insert_clickup_comment -> Supabase Realtime notifica o frontend
